This Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226 & 227 Of
The Constitution Of India, Praying To Declare That
The Proposed Action Of The Respondents Widening
B.D. Road, Chitradurga Town By Demolishing Existing
Building Of The Petitioner In The Schedule Property
Is Illegal As The Same Is Without Following The Due
Process Of Law As Provided Under The Provisions Of
The Right To Fair Compensation & Transparency In
Land Acquisition Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act,
2013, Etc.
 This Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing
In 'B' Group, This Day, Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:37460  WP No. 58033 of 2018  ORAL ORDER 1.

The case of the petitioner is that he is the owner of a shop situated at B.D.Road, Chitradurga Town and that the respondent - Authorities are trying to demolish the property of the petitioner for widening of the road.
It is alleged that they are doing it without following the due process of law.
2. Learned counsel appearing for respondent No.3 upon instructions submits that the road will be widened only after following the due process of law.

sentences.text:
In the light of the submission made by the learned counsel for respondent No.3, following order is passed:
ORDER i.
Respondent No.3 shall not demolish or dispossess the shop of the petitioner which is the subject matter of the writ petition without following the due process of law.
NC: 2024:KHC:37460 ii. The writ petition is disposed of.
